milestones.title: Founded in New Delhi
milestones.text: MedVance began with a simple goal — make quality medical supplies accessible to every healthcare provider in India.

milestones.title: 10,000 establishments served
milestones.text: Crossed our first major milestone, serving hospitals, clinics and labs across 12 states.

milestones.title: Pan-India logistics network
milestones.text: Launched regional fulfilment centres, cutting average delivery times dramatically nationwide.

milestones.title: Export operations begin
milestones.text: Extended our marketplace to the GCC, MEA and CIS regions with export-ready fulfilment.

milestones.title: 250,000+ SKUs live
milestones.text: Became one of India's most comprehensive B2B medical marketplaces with 4,500+ suppliers.

values.title: Access for all
values.text: Quality medical supplies should reach every provider, from metro hospitals to rural clinics.

values.title: Uncompromising quality
values.text: Every SKU is sourced from authorised manufacturers within a certified quality framework.

values.title: Partnership first
values.text: We win when our buyers and suppliers do — long-term relationships over one-off deals.

values.title: Speed with reliability
values.text: Fast fulfilment that healthcare teams can depend on when it matters most.

leadership.name: Dr. Ananya Rao
leadership.bio: A physician-turned-entrepreneur focused on fixing healthcare supply chains from the ground up.

leadership.name: Vikram Mehta
leadership.bio: Two decades in medical distribution and logistics across India and the GCC.

leadership.name: Priya Nair
leadership.bio: Builds and nurtures our network of 4,500+ manufacturers and authorised suppliers.
